function.name: web_search
function.description: Searches the live internet for up-to-date information, documentation, articles, or URLs. Call this tool when the user asks to find external learning materials, library docs (e.g. C++ references, GitHub repos), or facts not present in your context.

query.description: Specific search query (e.g. 'cppreference std::expected tutorial', 'boost beast websocket examples github').

max_results.description: Number of search results to return. Default is 3, max is 5.
